description: Rank HS chapters (2-digit) or headings (4-digit) by trade value for one reporter, flow, and annual or monthly period. Set parent_code and a deeper aggr_level to rank headings or subheadings within one chapter or heading. The tool uses matching TOTAL to identify the HS edition and queries explicit commodity codes in chunks, subdividing capped chunks. Shares use matching TOTAL or the reported parent value for a drill-down. Incomplete coverage returns available categories without ranks or shares and identifies unresolved codes. Defaults to World; optionally select one bilateral partner. Counterpart to comtrade_get_top_partners.

aggr_level.description: HS aggregation level: 2 = chapter, 4 = heading, 6 = subheading. Level 6 requires parent_code.

limit.description: Number of top commodity categories to return; totalCommodities counts every category retrieved.

parent_code.description: Two-digit HS chapter or four-digit heading. Supply a deeper aggr_level. Blank is treated as omitted.

partner_code.description: M49 partner code (0–999) for a bilateral relationship; omit for World aggregate (0).

period.description: Single period: annual (YYYY) or monthly (YYYYMM, month 01–12).

reporter_code.description: M49 numeric code of the reporting country (0–999).

name: comtrade_get_top_commodities

classificationCode.description: HS edition identified by matching TOTAL.

commodities.description: Top commodity categories sorted by descending trade value.

primaryValueUsd.description: Trade value in USD (FOB for exports, CIF for imports).

rank.description: Rank (1 = largest trade value), only with complete code coverage and known values.

residual.description: True on a catalogued residual code at this level (99, 9999, 999999 or historical 9999AA), ranked and shared like any other row. Absent on every other row.

sharePercent.description: Share of the matching parent or TOTAL trade value, only with complete code coverage.

coverageComplete.description: Whether complete coverage was established for the matching HS edition and requested scope.

coverageNotice.description: Explanation of coverage and ranking availability.

denominatorValueUsd.description: Matching parent or TOTAL value used as the share denominator, separate from the retrieved-category sum.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `keyless_hs_edition_unsupported`: An explicit HS edition requires authenticated access. `upstream_validation`: UN Comtrade rejects the supplied query dimensions. `invalid_upstream_response`: UN Comtrade returns a malformed response. `invalid_reporter_filter`: The query omits required reporter filtering. `rate_limited`: With TOTAL or the HS reference unavailable, UN Comtrade rate-limited the aggregate fallback through its retries. `upstream_unavailable`: With TOTAL or the HS reference unavailable, the aggregate fallback hit a UN Comtrade server error or network failure through its retries. `deadline_exceeded`: With TOTAL or the HS reference unavailable, the aggregate fallback did not complete within the call's time budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

missingCodes.description: Codes whose retrieval failed, remained capped, or did not fit the call's time budget; empty when the code universe is unavailable.

notice.description: Recovery hint when no data is returned, naming the code to query instead of a partner-only reporter_code (250 → 251, 158 → 490) or of a partner_code with a reporter-valid counterpart (840 → 842, 158 → 490); or what a residual row holds when it is on the returned page.

parentCode.description: HS chapter or heading selected for the drill-down.

totalCommodities.description: Total commodity categories returned by API.

totalValueUsd.description: Sum of primary values across all returned categories (before limit).

truncated.description: True when complete commodity-code coverage could not be established.

title: Get Top Trade Commodities
